mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -5%) in at least 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 0.4 percentage points signals a tightening labor market, which boosts wage pressures and inflation expectations, ultimately leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -3%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA - 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages signals deteriorating housing and overall demand, which depresses consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 6M MA and HOUST < 6M MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -4%) in at least 50% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% while CPIAUCSL rises above 4% for three consecutive months signals a monetary policy lag and inflationary pressure, which erodes real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND CPIAUCSL > 4% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month MA + 1% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +2%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% for three consecutive months signals rising household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses corporate revenue growth and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month MA + 5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -3%) in at least 50% of triggered quarters.
